description: This Java class defines ConstantColumnVector, a specialized implementation of ColumnVector that supports constant values across multiple rows for various data types, including primitives, arrays, maps, and complex types like Struct, CalendarInterval, and Variant.

classes.name: ConstantColumnVector
classes.description: A specialized ColumnVector that holds a constant value for all rows, supporting various data types and complex structures.

methods.name: closeIfFreeable
methods.description: No-op method; constants reuse data and are freed in close.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases resources by nullifying data fields and closing child vectors.

methods.name: hasNull
methods.description: Returns true if the entire vector is null.

methods.name: numNulls
methods.description: Returns the number of null entries, which is either the total number of rows or zero.

methods.name: isNullAt
methods.description: Checks if the value at a specific row is null.

methods.name: setNull
methods.description: Sets all rows as null.

methods.name: setNotNull
methods.description: Sets all rows as not null.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Returns the boolean value for all rows.

methods.name: setBoolean
methods.description: Sets a boolean value for all rows.
